hypotheses.exact: Every contracted full quadratic matches native scalar writes with relative RMS error below 1e-4.
hypotheses.compact: At least 3/4 residual axes in each early/middle layer achieve held-out centered R2 >= 0.90 with 16 covariance-weighted quadratic modes plus the exact linear term.
hypotheses.nonlinear: In at least two early/middle layers, median rank-16 R2 improves over the exact mean-state linear baseline by >= 0.10.
hypotheses.specific: In at least two early/middle layers, median residual-axis rank-16 R2 exceeds median random-output-axis R2 by >= 0.10.

scope: Axes are frozen from previous semantic-residual discovery; the predicted target is the FULL native write projected onto those directions, not a label-subtracted residual. No target-token labels enter prediction. Panels are disjoint from axis discovery and each other, but have been used in unrelated older studies. This is local function compression, not end-to-end causal validation.
